pixelTransfers.description: Exact raster recolors; at most 1000000 transfers per operation
Exact raster recolors; at most 1000000 transfers per operation

updates.description: One entry per state, each with the changes update_state takes. The whole list is one validated rewrite; a state may appear once.

unit.description: state assigns whole states. province assigns provinces and regroups the states a border cuts (conserving population, resources and buildings).

scope.description: Only these states take part; the rest keep their owners.

barriers.description: none ignores rivers, ranges and shores (nearest seed).

stateSize.description: Province unit: fragments below min provinces join a neighbour of the same owner.

groups.description: Culture or people group of provinces, { provinceId: group }. Growth across a group boundary costs like a ridge (groupPenalty), or never happens with groupHard. A state atom takes the group of most of its provinces.

groupPenalty.description: A step across a group boundary costs 1 + groupPenalty times more; default 2.

groupHard.description: Growth never crosses a group boundary, so a people keeps its own countries.

distribution.description: Required complete dependency policy when changes.type crosses land/sea/lake

readOnlySources.description: override copies game or dependency files that need the change into the mod.

mode.description: missing adds only absent positions; replace rewrites them for the selection.

kind.description: Adopt the current bytes of every output the world inventory (.hoi4-agent-world.json) records, so the next create_world overwrites them instead of refusing them as edited (MANAGED_OUTPUT_EDITED). Recorded files that are gone are dropped. Reports MAP_WORLD_OUTPUTS_RECORDED.

mode.description: connect adds a supply node to each selected state without one and links unconnected nodes by railway; replace rebuilds the whole network.

capital.description: Assertion for the capital derived from the exact victoryPoints payload; never writes a state capital field

seeds.description: { state }, { province } or a pixel { x, y }. The first is the capital.

regions.description: Strategic regions this country prefers to grow in.

overlord.description: Grow this country inside its overlord.

fixed.description: The country owns exactly its seeds and forced land and never grows, for a realm whose land is already settled.

mergeInto.description: Relabel the finished territory to another listed country (this tag stays a core).

__schema28.description: off skips the measurement; report adds border naturalness to the result; enforce blocks the write when the borders miss the targets.

__schema29.description: Override the targets (enrichment 1.6; straightness 0.12 for country borders and 0.25 for state borders).

pixels.description: Exact coordinates to recolor; at most 1000000 pixels per operation

oneOf.description: Even-odd polygon rasterization samples pixel centers and is rejected if it selects more than 1000000 pixels

__schema65.description: Declared selected cells; at most 1000000 pixels per operation

__schema69.description: Required deterministic polygon fill rule used for pixel-center sampling

__schema70.description: Integer raster-boundary coordinates; runtime bounds are x from 0 through raster width and y from 0 through raster height

__schema82.description: Include basic starting units and stockpiles and replace old-world startup/AI geography. Defaults on for reference-image worlds.

__schema84.description: Generate from one local reference image. Optional controls use normalized 0..1 source coordinates; crop uses source pixels. Labels and political semantics may need refinement.

__schema103.description: nearest (default) snaps every pixel to the closest palette colour. exact requires every pixel to equal a palette colour, trusts the classes as painted (no text masking, cleanup, smoothing or political inference) and fails with MAP_REFERENCE_PALETTE_UNKNOWN_COLOR naming any other colour, its count and source pixels.

__schema105.description: Registration of a picture made of drawn sheets onto the world frame (inline; use sheetsPath for a file). Each sheet maps its part of the picture with anchor, target and scale (or affine); the registered picture is read at the resolution the sheets need and every layer derives from it. Implies fit frame; width and height are required. Annotations, masks, labels and cities then use world coordinates.

__schema106.description: Registration of a drawn picture made of sheets onto the world frame (ADR 0067). Coordinates are normalised: picture coordinates to the picture, world coordinates to width x height.

__schema108.description: The picture these registrations were made for; a picture of another size or hash is refused.

__schema110.description: What world pixels outside every sheet become: open sea, or an error.

__schema114.description: Unique sheet id, named in diagnostics and artifacts.

__schema115.description: [left, top, right, bottom] of the sheet in normalised picture coordinates.

__schema117.description: Polygon in picture coordinates that cuts the sheet out of its box, so a neighbouring sheet inside the box is not pulled in.

__schema120.description: Picture point that maps to target.

__schema125.description: World units per picture unit along x and y; a negative value mirrors.

__schema127.description: General map [a, b, c, d, e, f] from picture to world, instead of anchor, target and scale.

__schema129.description: Where targets overlap the higher order wins; equal orders that overlap are an error.

__schema131.description: With a geography model: land intersection over union between the model and this reference below minLandIou (default 0.85) blocks the write with MAP_IMPORT_SOURCES_DISAGREE; below warnLandIou (default 0.95) it is a warning. The measured value is always in map-import-report.json.

__schema133.description: Workspace-relative .json file holding the sheet registration (reference-sheets version 1).

__schema135.description: contain (default) centres the picture with sea padding at a working size of at most 3,072 pixels per side. frame maps the picture (or its crop) onto exactly width x height, which must be given and have the same shape within 1%, and reads it at the frame resolution.

__schema141.description: Geography model version 1, inline: seas, lands, ranges, passes, volcanoes, plateaus, rivers, lakes, biomes, straits, sites and climate in normalized 0..1 world coordinates. Use geographyPath for models over a few hundred vertices. With preview:true it returns a model overlay and map-geography-report.json. Without preview the world is built from it: relief (ranges with passes, volcanoes, plateaus), rivers and lakes are synthesised; biomes, climate and fertility are not yet, and a model that declares them is blocked with MAP_GEOGRAPHY_SYNTHESIS_UNAVAILABLE.

__schema142.description: Geography model version 1. Normalized 0..1 coordinates over the whole world frame, origin top-left; lengths are fractions of the map width.

__schema191.description: With preview:true and a geography: run only the relief and river synthesis and report every river that cannot reach its mouth, with the divide that stops it, without writing or planning the map. Refused without preview or without a geography.

__schema193.description: Workspace-relative .json file holding a geography model (at most 4 MiB). Alternative to the inline geography field; give one of them.

__schema200.description: Land outlines in top-left pixel coordinates; omit for generated continents.

__schema208.description: Countries the world generates and writes (an array), or { source: "workspace", realms } for countries the workspace already declares: the world then places them from their capital, seeds, claims and exclusions and writes no country, flag, unit, country history, country name or bookmark file.

capital.description: World pixel, top-left origin, on land; the capital province. Capitals and seeds of different realms must be at least 10 pixels apart; each gets a province of its own.

seeds.description: Further world pixels whose provinces the country must own.

claim.description: Polygons in world pixels; land provinces more than half inside belong to the country.

exclude.description: Polygons in world pixels; land provinces more than half inside never belong to it.

weight.description: Relative share of the land claims leave free; default 1.

__schema219.description: Polygons in world pixels whose land provinces no country owns.

__schema221.description: Landmasses no country reaches: every province to the nearest capital, the whole landmass to one country, or unowned.

__schema224.description: keep (the default) also lists the continents of the active continent.txt after the generated ones; drop writes only the generated continents and warns about every active script that still names a dropped one (MAP_CONTINENT_DROPPED_REFERENCED).

__schema226.description: Where land drawn as snow in the reference keeps permanent snow; other drawn snow is ordinary land with seasonal snow. iceCapLatitude (default 0.8; 0 is the middle row, 1 the top and bottom edge, 1 turns ice caps off) and peakHeight (heightmap value, default 150; 256 turns it off). paintedHeight (heightmap value, no default) is the lowest the snow line of painted mountains, volcanoes and impassable land may go; without it that line runs from 232 at the equator to 140 at the poles, and 256 puts none. snowlines keeps permanent snow only above the snow lines of ranges and painted mountains. MAP_PERMANENT_SNOW_SHARE reports the result against the base game, by source; a synthesisCheck preview estimates it as MAP_PERMANENT_SNOW_ESTIMATE.

__schema229.description: Without a geography: the number of generated rivers. With a geography: an integer limits the number of unnamed river systems, an object { density } sets the share of land the network covers; the rivers the model names are always routed.

density.description: Share of land pixels the unnamed river network covers, 0 to 0.04; the named rivers come on top. Default 0.02 (the base game has 0.023).

__schema231.description: Relief of a world built from a geography model: height scale and detail. Needs geography.

scale.description: Height of everything above the lowland: vanilla (the default) follows the base game, low is 25% lower, dramatic 15% higher.

detail.description: Full-resolution roughness of the terrain, 0 to 1; default 0.5.

painted.description: With a reference picture and a geography model: raise the relief toward the painted mountain, hills and volcano classes before the rivers are routed, blurred over falloffPx so slopes stay natural. Peaks are 0 to 1 on the range relief scale (defaults mountain 0.82, hills 0.27, volcano 0.9, near the base game; impassable land 0.95, which is raised even when this is off). Off by default.

falloffPx.description: Blur radius of class edges in pixels; default 24.

mode.description: sea-band (default when edge is given) clears land from the east and west edges and the poles to open sea; rim ends land at the seam in an impassable snow range whose seam provinces are impassable states, but sea at the seam stays sailable; wall fills rimPx at the east and west edges with land over the full height, in impassable states, so nothing crosses the seam by land or sea; none keeps the picture and warns about land cut by the wrapping seam.

bandPx.description: East and west sea band in pixels; default max(192, 4% of the width), at most a quarter of the width.

polarPx.description: North and south sea band in pixels; default 64, at most a quarter of the height. 0 lets land reach the top and bottom edges.

rimPx.description: Rim range or wall width in pixels for mode rim or wall; default 160 for rim and 48 for wall, at most a quarter of the width. The inner edge of the wall is ragged between 60% and 100% of it.

wallTerrain.description: Mode wall only: the look of the wall. auto (default) takes, for each row, the terrain of the nearest land the wall meets on that side, or snow toward the poles and mountain elsewhere where it meets only water, smoothed along the edge. A list of {y0, y1, kind} segments (rows counted from the top, inclusive) sets it by rows; uncovered rows fall back to auto.

__schema247.description: Write the base map's north and south frame borders and logo frame into ambient_object.txt, placed for the world size. Off by default.

__schema249.description: Colour palette set for the calibrated land colour map: the base game, a greener fertile palette, a drier arid palette, or custom with colormap.palette. Setting it selects the calibrated colour map.

profile.description: calibrated writes a dark, varied colour map calibrated to the base game; legacy keeps the original flat tints. Defaults to calibrated when look is set, otherwise legacy.

palette.description: Class colours for look custom: the intended colour map value of each class.

__schema253.description: legacy (default) keeps the warped Voronoi provinces and breadth-first clusters, so a seed gives the same world as before; feature-aware cuts provinces along rivers, ridges, steep slopes and shores, sizes them by terrain, fertility and coast, and clusters states and regions along natural lines. A world given a geography defaults to feature-aware.

model.description: geography (default for a geography world) plans ports, population, state categories, infrastructure, factories, resources, victory points, names and railway costs from the model: fertility, rivers, the coast, passes, ranges and sites. legacy keeps the random economy.

__schema256.description: Also write a sea crossing for every channel narrower than maxGapPx that one sea province fills between two landmasses and that the model does not declare as a strait. Needs a geography.

maxGapPx.description: Widest channel written as a crossing, in pixels; default 24 (about 170 km).

__schema260.description: Size bands and strengths of the feature-aware partition; refused with partition legacy.

landArea.description: Typical land province area in pixels by ground. Defaults follow landProvincePixels (0.35, 1, 2.2 and 3.4 times, scaled so the mean stays landProvincePixels). fertile must not exceed hills, nor hills mountain.

seaArea.description: Sea province area in pixels near a coast and on the open sea. Defaults follow seaProvincePixels (0.5 and 2.4 times, scaled so the mean stays seaProvincePixels).

lakeArea.description: Lake province area in pixels; default 6000. A lake no larger than this stays one province.

provincesPerState.description: [smallest, largest] land provinces per state; the preferred size is the geometric mean.

regionSize.description: [smallest, largest] land provinces per strategic region.

barrierStrength.description: How strongly borders are pulled onto natural lines, 0 to 60; default 20.

minProvincePixels.description: No province is planned smaller than this; default 40. The engine floor is 8.

narrowStraitPx.description: A sea channel at most this wide gets two sea provinces across it; default 24.

areaByRow.description: [row, factor] points, row 0 the top edge and 1 the bottom, in increasing row order: the land province area at a row is multiplied by the factor, linearly between points and held beyond the ends, after the plan is scaled to the base area. States keep their province counts, so they grow by the same factor. MAP_PARTITION_AREA_BY_ROW reports the mean province area per band.

__schema273.description: Measure how well the new world’s province, state, region and country borders follow rivers, slopes and shores. enforce blocks the write below the targets and needs the feature-aware partition; omitted measures nothing.

__schema275.description: Add replace_path for the base game states, countries, units, strategic regions, supply areas and bookmarks to descriptor.mod.

to.description: One ID replaces; several IDs copy the referencing assignment once per ID; null removes it.
